## 🎵 PulseMusic Pull Request

### 📋 Overview of Changes
- Summary of modifications, bug fixes, or enhancements.
- Issues addressed: `Fixes #...`

### 🔍 Category
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (audio buffering, voice chat disconnects, downloaders)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (platform resolver, player command, filter)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization / memory leak fix
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Configuration / Build update

### ✅ Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code passes syntax and compilation checks (`python3 -m py_compile`).
- [ ] Preserved or added copyright headers to modified files.
- [ ] Tested live voice chat playback with both audio and video streams.
- [ ] No secrets or session strings included in commits.
